name: covenant-crew
description: Three-agent pipeline that formalizes specs and legal clauses, proves contradictions and security gaps with Z3, then presents verified repairs and exports patched specs, property tests or redlines.

pipeline.name: Formalizer
pipeline.input: A changed requirements.md, or pasted legal clauses.
pipeline.output: ParseRequest JSON with a typed deontic AST summary.

pipeline.name: Z3 Inquisitor
pipeline.output: Five verdicts, Unsat Cores, Phantom Witnesses, CWE gaps and Resolution Payloads.

pipeline.name: Redline & PBT Synthesizer
pipeline.input: Z3 Inquisitor report and the user's Chalice choice.
pipeline.output: Patched EARS requirements.md plus a fast-check test, or a Legal Redline diff plus a negotiation summary.
